'''Miles''' (Japanese: '''アキヒト''' ''Akihito'') is a recurring character in [[Pokémon Adventures]].

==History==
==={{MangaArc|Yellow}}===
Miles debuted in ''[[PS046|Whacked by Marowak!]]''. He was hired by [[Agatha]] to capture {{adv|Red}}'s {{p|Pikachu}}, [[Pika]]. By wearing a special bodysuit he developed, Miles fooled Pika into thinking he was its {{pkmn|Trainer}}, who had gone missing after a battle with the [[Elite Four]]. He was pursued by {{adv|Yellow}}, who chased Miles into [[Celadon City]], but was unable to determine his exact whereabouts due to it being dark out. Luring Yellow into a trap, Miles repeatedly struck her with his {{p|Marowak}}'s {{m|Bonemerang}}. By having his {{p|Persian}} scratch some walls, it released loud sound waves that masked the sound of the incoming bone.

In ''[[PS048|Paras Sight]]'', Yellow allowed herself to be hit by Marowak's Bonemerang in order to tie her [[Poké Ball]]s onto the bone. When the bone returned to its owner, Yellow's [[Ratty]] and [[Dody]] leapt in and freed Pika from Miles's grasp. Miles attempted to flee, but was surrounded by [[Erika]], [[Brock]], [[Misty]], and {{adv|Blaine}}. With a combination attack launched by Yellow's Pokémon, Miles was surrounded by a pile of rubble, trapping and defeating him. Agatha had her {{p|Gastly}} possess Miles's unconscious body in an attempt to silence him and remove any leads that would help in finding Red. Gastly's gaseous body allowed it to dodge any move thrown at it, but it was eventually taken down by {{adv|Blue}} when he arrived on the scene. Blue then revealed to everyone that Miles was hired by Agatha, as he recognized the strategy her Gastly used from a previous encounter with her.

In ''[[PS055|The Primeape Directive]]'', it was revealed that Miles was taken to the [[Cinnabar Gym]] to recuperate from the injuries he sustained while possessed by Agatha's Gastly. In ''[[PS076|Take a Chance on Chansey]]'', while Blaine was away, [[Evan]] routinely checked in on Miles and kept his Pokémon fed until Miles eventually woke up from his coma.

In ''[[PS083|Bang the Drum, Slowbro]]'', the Cinnabar Gym was attacked by a multitude of {{type|Dragon}} Pokémon commanded by the Elite Four. Miles and Evan kept themselves hidden while they waited for Yellow and the [[Gym Leader]]s to defeat the Elite Four.

==={{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}===
In ''[[PS153|Oh, It's Ho-Oh!]]'', Miles and Evan entered in the Pokémon League. As they had no Gym Badges, they had to take part in the preliminary rounds. Due to the [[Masked Man]]'s attack on the [[Indigo Plateau]], the tournament was canceled and they never got a chance to compete.

==={{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}===
In ''[[PS295|Double Down Deoxys]]'', Miles and Evan were seen visiting Blaine at the Cinnabar Gym.
